summary: This video announces the Dragonheir Halloween event running from October 28 to November 4 (UTC). Players can participate by opening the official Facebook post linked in the video description and commenting their devious prank idea. Every eligible participant receives a CDK code containing 300 Wyrmarrow and 5 Thunder Gummies.
tips: Comment a prank idea on the official Dragonheir Facebook post before November 4 to get a CDK for 300 Wyrmarrow and 5 Thunder Gummies.
